_comment: Bleakhold: Crucible of Onyxia -- a 10-man custom raid on its own map. package.py build reads this.
Map id 902: Royale already took 901 (the next free id above stock's 724 and the realm's Emberwing Hollow
740); this build must still run the same id-conflict check royale_v1's README describes
(bleakhold_royale_check.sql-equivalent) against the live world database before install, since the realm's
patches may have claimed ids in the 900s or the 5220+ zone/area range already.
Zone 5220 / areas 5221-5223: Royale owns 5200-5213 and 5214-5217 (POI-only), the realm's own patches use
5006-5018, 5100, 5101 and 6001+, so 5220 keeps clear; re-check on the VPS build same as royale_v1.
instance_type 0 (none: one shared world map) for the REVIEW build, so the map can be walked in game. The
target is a 10-man raid (instance_type 2), but the core refuses a raid-type map outright until it has an
instance_template row AND MapDifficulty rows (MapMgr::PlayerCannotEnter returns CANNOT_ENTER_UNINSTANCED_
DUNGEON / DIFFICULTY_UNAVAILABLE BEFORE the GM bypass, so even a GM cannot .tele in), and this forge writes
neither. A type-0 map is not a 'dungeon' to the core (MapEntry::IsDungeon is true only for types 1 and 2),
so a GM can .tele straight in: .go xyz 0 300 30 902 (the entrance). Switching to 2 later is one line here
plus those two server-side rows. No battleground section either way (that's instance_type 3
only, config.py raises ConfigError otherwise). A raid still needs an AzerothCore instance_template row
and the InstanceScript binding -- that is server-side SQL/C++ (Phase 2 of the plan doc), not something
this DBC config produces.
zone.set_flags: none of Royale's ARENA/NO_FLY_ZONE -- this is a normal instanced PvE raid, not an FFA
zone. clear_flags drops the same rule-changing bits royale_v1 does (duels, rest, sanctuary, cities,
ghost revival, outdoor PvP) so a raid with no explicit flags doesn't inherit anything stray from its
template zone; package.py fails on anything left over outside HARMLESS_TEMPLATE_FLAGS, same check as
royale.
zone.template 215 (Blackrock Depths) for ambience/music closer to a lava-and-dragon raid than
Duskwood; swap for another verified 3.3.5a zone template on the VPS build if the ambience doesn't fit.
light.skybox: StratholmeSkybox (a dim, enclosed-feeling sky) as a placeholder for an indoor-feeling raid;
DeathSkybox or IceCrownDarkSky are the other verified alternatives royale_v1's own comment lists.
corpse_map -1, corpse_x/y 0: same as royale, release-to-graveyard behaviour is server-side (Phase 2).

map.name: Bleakhold: Crucible of Onyxia
map.description_horde: Three lairs, one road: the fire-cult's chasm, the scorched causeway, and Onyxia's own.
map.description_alliance: Three lairs, one road: the fire-cult's chasm, the scorched causeway, and Onyxia's own.

archives._comment: patch-K.MPQ, NOT Royale's patch-Q: the two maps keep separate client archives so a Crucible build never clobbers a deployed Royale map (both would otherwise pack into patch-Q). K is free: it is not in reserved_letters (the realm-rebuild set) and not in the optional packs, and it was not among the realm's patches on the VPS. Verify it is free on the launcher before deploying.
